title: SAP: How enterprise AI governance secures profit margins
summary: SAP discusses how enterprise AI governance helps secure profit margins by replacing probabilistic statistical AI with deterministic control systems that deliver more reliable and consistent outputs for business-critical decisions.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of unreliable AI outputs in enterprise environments where statistical AI models can produce inconsistent results (e.g., 10% error rates in simple tasks like word counting).
why_valuable: Provides enterprises with predictable, controlled AI systems that reduce decision-making risk and protect profit margins across business operations.
